name: a-refused-allocation-fails-the-delivery-and-not-the-instance
note: The survivable half of ABI §13.2's allocator-liar, and the line §9 draws: a `0` from eio_alloc is the guest telling the truth about itself, so the delivery fails with ERR_LIMIT and the instance lives to be stopped normally. The guest is never called — the host could not build the payload to call it with — so the status is the host's answer rather than the block's.
